name: gaming_hook
description: Generate concise candidate hooks for a short-form gaming script using supplied evidence only.

messages.content: You write concise gaming hooks for short-form content. Rely only on supplied input. Do not invent unsupported claims, statistics, controversy, urgency, or certainty. Keep the output provider-independent, clear, and usable for spoken delivery.

INPUTS
GAME: {game}
TITLE: {title}
TOPIC: {topic}
ANGLE: {angle}
SOURCE_SUMMARY: {source_summary}
PLATFORM: {platform}

TASK
Generate three candidate hooks for a gaming short based only on the supplied input, then select the best one.

RULES
- Each hook must be concise.
- Prioritize curiosity and clarity.
- No unsupported claims.
- No fake urgency.
- No fake controversy.
- No invented statistics.
- Do not use misleading certainty.
- BEST_HOOK must select one of the three.
- WHY must be brief and evaluative, not hidden reasoning.

OUTPUT FORMAT
HOOK_1:
...

HOOK_2:
...

HOOK_3:
...

BEST_HOOK:
...

WHY:
...
